application: The Sphere Observatory — current source build
title: The Sphere from the polar court

assumptions.collection: Optional Collection study v1: three prescribed shade routes, 18 intact/12 surviving shades with selectable planar disk, square, curved spherical-cap or trimmed-cap geometry, six analytic elliptical wounds, two stellar-service rings. Layout is provisional. ShellShine uses 192 equal-area samples of macro albedo and direct light, one diffuse bounce with adjustable strength. Direct occlusion uses seven or nineteen shared stellar samples without the station, or a selectable 19/64/128/256 common sample set with the station enabled, with receiver self-exclusion. Trimmed caps have planar side cuts parallel to travel; the width is adjustable. On supported GPUs, linear half-float radiance is filtered before exposure and SDR tone mapping. Unsupported GPUs retain display-colour supersampling. In the designed layout, Smooth edges integrates eight subpixel primary rays near analytic Shade boundaries before the local geometry and volume passes. Other pixels keep their centre ray; geometric depth also remains centre sampled. An optional contrast-directed display filter can soften fine detail. Construction texture pitches are fixed in kilometres and filtered with footprint. Surface detail, haze, shade penumbrae and damage are approximate. No mirror delivery, concealment, ablation, orbital evolution or light travel time is simulated.
assumptions.geometry: Analytic shell and star with camera-relative triangle geometry. Wound walls share a precise local boundary with the shell and use adaptive curved segments, angled strata and torn ribs. Revision 2 discovers intact and broken Shade boundaries automatically. Revision 3 joins two continuous faces with a 180 m body, finished perimeter panels and exposed fracture structure. Revision 2 retains its thin skin and local edge sections; revision 1 retains the original service strip. LOD follows projected feature size, with subpixel retirement and retained world addresses. Thickness and engineering dimensions are provisional. Connected ground has a bounded resident neighbourhood; older field revisions retain their original walking bounds. Shared logarithmic depth; panoramas assemble six geometry views.
assumptions.lighting: Finite stellar disk occlusion, image-derived 192-region first bounce, two camera-local directional shadow regions with approximate finite-star filtering, shared roughness/metalness/normal materials on Shade skin and Wound structures, and depth-clipped volumetric clouds with self-shadow sampling and optional tenuous cavity dust. ShellShine supplies a coarse environment reflection approximation; no reflection capture or converged global multiple scattering. No photometric calibration.
assumptions.surface: Version 2: one oriented habitat waist, supporting machinery and two polar entries. Far reflectance is the linear-sRGB mean of original biome images. Nearby colour comes from those images. New landings use connected geographic terrain with retained support and a coarse surrounding band; older scene revisions retain their original patches. The rest of the shell remains analytic.
assumptions.dynamics: Inspection cameras follow the selected Shade frame through simulation and scrubbing; detach allows independent flight. Level lock removes roll within 1 km without changing pitch. Shade routes follow the habitat ribbons on actively maintained small circles. Artificial local 9.81 m/s² walking gravity and atmospheric containment are assumptions. Shade periods are authored, not Keplerian. Exterior fleets follow illustrative deterministic motion; warfare is not simulated. Instantaneous light; no retarded transport.
assumptions.stars: Illustrative distant stars and filtered debris silhouettes; nearby original wreckage geometry supplies parallax and detailed silhouettes. The earlier low-resolution illustration plates are archived. No astronomical catalogue or inherited external game assets.
assumptions.watershedPack: Explicit schema-1 Watershed pack address, geography/art revisions and seed. Original 640 km terrain retained. Surrounding irregular drainage, bank routes and lake are analytic shell materials with shared CPU masks, not displaced regional terrain or a hydrodynamic simulation. Walking remains bounded to a local 2.4 km patch.
assumptions.watershed: Optional Watershed province revision 1, seed and unit-vector anchor saved independently of shell layout 2. A 640-km deterministic catchment graph supplies terrain, receiving basins and smoothed river ribbons. Curved water-garden structures are shared rendered/collision geometry. Water is a static surface, not a hydrodynamic simulation. Local canopy and a six-metre terrace inspection are included; this is not a new walking level.
assumptions.assets: Image maps are selected from the current viewing frustum and their distance bands, uploaded before revealing a new view, and reused from cache. Distant views use the numeric world palette. Texture arrays reserve bounded GPU capacity on first use; loading is selective by image, not a GPU paging system. A failed image can be retried or bypassed with the simpler surface.
